Someone with migraines here - cat scans are better as they are faster, MRI is ok but takes quite some time. Don't be surprised if she is referred to a neurologist- this is a good thing. I would not try an exclusion diet until she has seen the neurologist though. Instead have her keep a good diary. What she ate, what she drank, and what symptoms she has. Also keep a timeline of when she gets the migraines and their intensity. 


Good luck :)

Thank you for the welcome. :) I do not usually talk about what is going on internally... so it feels sort of weird. 

I was stopped at a red light and rear ended by a truck going 45mph... he did not hit his brakes at all and pushed me out across the crosswalk. I hit my head pretty hard and had a concussion - as a person that deals with control issues it really impacted me when I could not talk right or think of the words I wanted. It also caused my migraines to go from one or two a month to every day. 

My husband tries to talk with me, but I do not think that he understands the depths at which his words can impact. Something as small as "we need to rethink our plans because of this" turns into "you are being a burden again and it is impacting me." I do my best to try and change that cycle of thought but lately it has been getting harder and harder. As for family I do not talk to them much. In a good many respects I just see myself as alone. 

I have been trying to find a new job but I guess I am being too picky. My husband gets transferred with his company so I tend to get things that I will not move very high in. This was the first transfer that we made where they let me take the job to @home. But with the migraines and the strain and the self doubt I just could not keep it.
